🛠️ ChipWits Worlds Devlog: Goodbye static HUD buttons! We replaced our Unity action bar with a 40x25 retro terminal that supports ANSI escape sequences.

Best part: you get to code the BBS yourself (in C or 65C02 assembly)! The default OS renders clickable action buttons, gives you a command shell for commands like move r4f20 (spin 180 deg, fwd 20), scrolls colony logs, and links multiple robots. 💻
